about_the_game:
Step into the elemental world of Stop the Blight with the game's original soundtrack, composed by DavidKBD—a rich and atmospheric collection of music that blends orchestral, ambient, and metal influences to reflect the game’s unfolding struggle between light and corruption.

This DLC includes:

  • All 6 full-length tracks in both MP3 and WAV formats

  • Loop-ready audio for fans who want to immerse themselves in the music beyond the game
